name: Ukraine

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands, blue over yellow.
flag.symbolism: It is widely interpreted as a blue sky above golden fields of wheat.

hook: Blue sky over a golden wheat field: Ukraine is just two horizontal halves, while Sweden arranges the same colors as a cross.
trivia: Blue-and-yellow banners were used by Ukrainians in Lviv during the revolutions of 1848.
Ukraine is the largest country lying entirely within Europe.
